Name: Vincent To Veronica Dialogue and Gender change
Author: upforkilling
Description:
[size=4][b]Description[/b][/size]
[color=#D4D4D8]This mod changes Vincent into Veronica and changes their gender to Female.
It also adds more dialogue in general. I have given Veronica 24 new lines of Hear level related Daily Dialogues.
Best enjoyed with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/40599]vincent girl mod[/url] It will work without it, but why would you use it...
Original:
This Dose Not change any Dialogue from any events or other NPCs, so this mod should not conflict with any other mods.[/color]
[color=#D4D4D8]V2:
This Changes Penny, sam, and Jodi's Daily Dialogue, and all event Dialogue that mentions Vincent. This my conflict with mods that affect those NPC's. Not that It will brake anything, you might just not see the right Dialogue.[/color]

[color=#D4D4D8]I originally was going to a female mod for Willy for [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/38409]the willy girl mod [/url]but it seamed to intimidating. So I used Vincent for testing, as they barley have any Dialogue and only 1 event of their own.[/color]
[size=4][b]Installation instructions[/b][/size]
[size=3][color=#D4D4D8]Place unzipped mod in mods folder[/color][/size]

[size=4][b]Main features[/b][/size]
[color=#D4D4D8]Gender and name swap.
24 new lines of Hear level Daily Dialogue.
New festival  Dialogue.[/color]

[size=4][b]Requirements[/b][/size]
[color=#D4D4D8]Content Patcher[/color]
SMAPI - Stardew Modding API
[size=4][b]Shout outs[/b][/size]
[size=3][color=#D4D4D8][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/profile/ZEROp1xe1]ZEROp1xe1[/url] is making female sprites for every one, check them out.[/color][/size]
